definitions.full: H1918. hadas הֲדַס noun masculine Isa 55:13 myrtle (-tree), only late (Late Hebrew, Aram id. ; Arabic (in the dialect of Yemen); also , Aramaic אָסָה , ; compare Löw No. 25 ) — absolute ׳ה 41:19 ; Neh 8:15 ; הֲדַ֑ס Isa 55:13 ; plural הַהֲדַסִּים Zech 1:8 2 t.
